column2: The Nikkei 225 is Japan's premier stock market index, tracking 225 large companies listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. It is price-weighted, similar to the Dow Jones.
The MOEX Russia Index (formerly MICEX) is the main ruble-denominated stock index of the Moscow Exchange, tracking the 50 most liquid Russian stocks.
The IPC (Indice de Precios y Cotizaciones) is Mexico's main stock market index on the Bolsa Mexicana de Valores, tracking 35 leading companies.

column1: What is the Baltic Dry Index?
column2: The Baltic Dry Index measures the cost of shipping raw materials by sea. It tracks rates for Capesize, Panamax, and Supramax vessels. Key indicator of global trade activity.
The Athens Exchange (ATHEX) is Greece's stock exchange. The General Index tracks all listed companies. Greece is significant in global shipping and Mediterranean finance.
Brent Crude is a major trading classification of sweet light crude oil from the North Sea. It serves as a benchmark for pricing two-thirds of the world's internationally traded crude oil.
Currency signals indicate exchange rate movements. JPY/USD tracks yen strength, RUB/USD tracks ruble, MXN/USD tracks peso. Strength = lower number means currency buying more dollars.
